_comment: Pins the PRESERVED legacy (schema_version <= 2) fail-open empty-tally rule (RFC-MACP-0012 4.1, Legacy empty-tally rule). RFC-MACP-0012 8 requires a stored policy to evaluate under its declared schema_version forever, so this arm is normative and permanent even though its behavior is the bug reported in issue #98. Paired with decision_empty_tally_binding.json, which is the same transcript at schema_version 3.
description: Decision Mode: schema_version 2 keeps the legacy fail-open empty-tally rule, for replay.

policy.description: Unanimous vote, initiator-only commitment, legacy schema_version 2 fail-open empty-tally semantics.

messages._comment: schema_version 2, empty tally, require_vote_quorum set EXPLICITLY to false (the default is also false; it is spelled out here so the fixture pins the flag's effect rather than the default's). Set it to true and this message is DENIED -- see decision_legacy_require_vote_quorum.json. The legacy rule is FAIL-OPEN: 'unanimous' produces no result, and with require_vote_quorum false the absence of votes does not block the positive commitment, so it SEALS. This fixture pins preservation for REPLAY (RFC-MACP-0012 8), not endorsement -- the identical transcript under schema_version 3 is DENIED, see decision_empty_tally_binding.json. An implementation that 'fixes' schema_version <= 2 to fail closed silently breaks replay of every stored session bound to a v1 or v2 policy.

payload.reason: positive commitment on an empty decisive tally under legacy semantics
